settings.title: Settings
settings.openHelp: When closed, the page stays visible but nobody can vote or suggest.
settings.votingEndsHelp: Voting and suggestions close by themselves at this date and time (Paris time). Leave empty for no end. The list stays visible.
settings.showCountdownHelp: Shows the time left on the mod page. Voting closes at the end date either way.
settings.maxSuggestionsHelp: Removed suggestions count too. Withdrawn and promoted ones free a slot.
settings.serverHelp: New mods must run on this version and loader. Mods already in the list aren’t checked again.

official.empty: No official mods yet. Add one, or promote a suggestion.
official.removeBody: The mod and its votes are deleted. It can be added or suggested again later.

add.title: Add a mod to the official list
add.lede: Pick it from Modrinth or CurseForge, or add it by hand if it’s on neither.
add.name: Name
add.iconHelp: Optional. The site downloads it once. PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF, up to 512 KB.

suggestions.lede: Sorted by score. Removing a suggestion hides it and its votes, and tells the person who suggested it why.

edit.title: Edit {name}
edit.lede: Change the reason or who gets the credit. The votes stay.
edit.reasonHelp: Shown with the suggestion. Leave it empty to remove the text.
edit.proposerHelp: Search by name or email. Their own vote on this mod is cleared.

convert.title: Convert {name}
convert.lede: It’s a {source} mod now. Pick its new source: the votes, the proposer and the reason stay, and the details are replaced.
convert.iconHelp: Optional. Leave it empty to keep the current icon.

refresh.title: Refresh metadata from Modrinth and CurseForge?
refresh.lede: LNB looks this mod up again at its source and shows what changed. Nothing is saved until you apply it. | LNB looks these {count} mods up again at their source and shows what changed. Nothing is saved until you apply it.
refresh.coversCompat: Whether it still runs on the server, shown as a warning and never changed
refresh.manualNote: {count} mod was added by hand and has no source, so it’s skipped. | {count} mods were added by hand and have no source, so they’re skipped.
refresh.nothing: No mod here comes from Modrinth or CurseForge, so there’s nothing to refresh.
refresh.reviewLede: Untick what you want to keep as it is. Nothing is saved until you apply.
refresh.upToDate: The mod matches its source. | All {count} mods match their source.
refresh.goneBody: {source} doesn’t have this project anymore. Check whether it was renamed or deleted.
refresh.incompatibleBody: It has no file for the server’s Minecraft version and loader anymore. It stays in the list.
refresh.applyFailed: {count} mod couldn’t be updated. Try again. | {count} mods couldn’t be updated. Try again.

removeModal.title: Remove {name}?
removeModal.reasonHelp: Shown to the person who suggested it.
removeModal.placeholder: For example: it doesn’t run with Create yet.
removeModal.note: The suggestion still counts toward their limit, and the mod can’t be suggested again. You can restore it later.

rateLimit.title: Rate limiting
rateLimit.lede: Pick what the site should do right now. A change applies within seconds and is logged on the Overview.

event.label: Event night
event.description: For a full room on one Wi-Fi. The limits per IP address are multiplied by {factor}. The limits per account stay.

off.label: Off
off.description: No limits at all. Use it to test, then switch back.

rateLimit.offDescription: Nothing slows down floods or abuse of the API and the short links. Switch back to Normal when you are done.
rateLimit.unaffected: Sign-in, join tickets and the mod search keep their own limits in every mode.
rateLimit.failed: That didn’t work. Check your connection, then try again.
rateLimit.loadFailed: The rate limiting mode couldn’t be loaded. Check your connection, then reload the page.

flags.partsOff: This feature is off, so its parts are off too.
flags.failed: That didn’t work. Check your connection, then try again.
flags.loadFailed: The feature flags couldn’t be loaded. Check your connection, then reload the page.

signIn_eartsup.label: e-artsup
signIn_eartsup.description: Refuses new sign-ins from e-artsup accounts. Admins can still sign in.

signIn_iseg.label: ISEG
signIn_iseg.description: Refuses new sign-ins from ISEG accounts. Admins can still sign in.

modList.label: Mod list
modList.description: The public mod list page and everything it does.

modList_voting.label: Voting
modList_voting.description: Votes on mods. The scores stay visible.

modList_suggestions.label: Suggestions
modList_suggestions.description: Suggesting a mod and editing a suggestion.

modList_search.label: Mod search
modList_search.description: The Modrinth and CurseForge search used to suggest a mod.

modList_icons.label: Mod icons
modList_icons.description: Mod icons, and the icons of search results.

warden_linking.description: Linking and unlinking a Minecraft account, linking devices of the mod, and revoking them.

warden_appeals.label: Ban appeals
warden_appeals.description: Sending an appeal against a Warden ban.

warden_serverApi.description: What the Warden plugin on the Minecraft server calls. The plugin gets a 503 while this is off.

warden_clientApi.description: What the LNB Warden mod calls: linking a device, join tickets and presence. The mod gets a 503 while this is off.

avatars_microsoftPhoto.label: Microsoft photo at sign-in
avatars_microsoftPhoto.description: Fetching and saving the Microsoft profile photo when someone signs in. Saved photos stay.

events.label: Events
events.description: The events pages, their API, and the Events link in the header.

events_home.label: Events on the front page
events_home.description: The next event and the agenda on the front page.

jobs_deleteInactive.label: Delete inactive accounts
jobs_deleteInactive.description: The nightly deletion of accounts with no sign-in for 24 months.

jobs_pruneAvatars.label: Prune profile photos
jobs_pruneAvatars.description: The removal of photos no account uses.

jobs_closeStaleSessions.label: Close stale Warden sessions
jobs_closeStaleSessions.description: The check that closes Warden sessions with no heartbeat.

events_registration.description: Registering, joining the waitlist and cancelling. Pages stay, and managers can still add and remove people.

push_subscribe.label: Allowing notifications
push_subscribe.description: The prompt after a registration and the switch in the account settings. Devices already allowed keep receiving.

push_newEvents.label: New-event notifications
push_newEvents.description: Announcing a new event to followers. Nothing is queued while this is off.

push_reminders.label: Event reminders
push_reminders.description: Reminders before events people registered for.

push_spots.label: Waitlist spot notifications
push_spots.description: The notification when a place opens, or a manager adds someone.

jobs_pushDeliver.label: Send notifications
jobs_pushDeliver.description: The minute-by-minute job that queues reminders and sends what is due.

jobs_pushPrune.label: Prune notification log
jobs_pushPrune.description: The nightly removal of notifications older than 90 days and of dead devices.

team.label: Team page
team.description: The public team page and its footer link. Admins can still manage the team.

team_join.label: Join the team button
team_join.description: The button at the bottom of the team page. The saved link stays.

partners.label: Partners page
partners.description: The public partners page and its footer link. Admins can still manage the partners.

partners_contact.label: Support LNB band
partners_contact.description: The “Want to support LNB?” band at the bottom of the partners page. The saved link stays.

partnerEvents.label: Partner event pages
partnerEvents.description: The public pages for events other organizations run, such as Arena League University, and their API.

partnerEvents_interest.label: Interest in partner events
partnerEvents_interest.description: Saving interest in a partner event's games. Students can still withdraw.

partnerEvents_teams.label: Teams in partner events
partnerEvents_teams.description: Creating teams, inviting and joining in a partner event. Players can still leave.

jobs_purgePartnerEvents.label: Deleting partner event data
jobs_purgePartnerEvents.description: The nightly deletion of interest, teams and dates of birth 60 days after a partner event is closed.

jobs_prunePartnerLogos.label: Pruning partner logos
jobs_prunePartnerLogos.description: The nightly removal of logos no partner uses.

shortLinks.label: Short links
shortLinks.description: The /go/ links. Visitors see that the link is off. Managers can still manage them.

shortLinks_tracking.description: Links keep counting clicks but stop recording who clicked. People already recorded stay.

apiKeys.description: Every API key stops working and answers 503, so integrations are cut off at once. Admins can still manage keys.

jobs_pruneApiKeys.label: Prune API keys
jobs_pruneApiKeys.description: The removal of API keys that stopped working 90 days ago, and of old call counts.

economy_transfers.description: Payments, bets and payouts from the Minecraft server. Balances can still be read.

economy_sharedAccounts.label: Shared accounts
economy_sharedAccounts.description: Opening shared accounts, inviting players and changing members. Existing accounts keep working.

economy_baltop.label: Baltop
economy_baltop.description: The public ranking of the richest players and shared accounts.

economy_serverApi.label: Minecraft server API
economy_serverApi.description: Every economy call from the Minecraft server answers 503.

jobs_economySnapshot.label: Economy stats
jobs_economySnapshot.description: The nightly save of the economy charts, and closing the bank accounts of deleted players.

errors.notCaptain: Only the captain can do that.
errors.rosterLocked: Registration is closed, so teams can’t take new players anymore.
errors.notInTeam: That person isn’t in this team.
errors.cancelled: This event is cancelled, so it can’t be changed anymore.
errors.started: The event has started, so registrations can’t change anymore.
errors.full: The event is full. Tick “Register even though it’s full” to add them anyway.
errors.notRegistered: They weren’t registered anymore. Reload the page.
errors.imageTooLarge: This image is over 10 MB. Pick a smaller one.
errors.imageUnreadable: This file isn’t an image the site can read. Use a PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF.
errors.imageUnreachable: The image couldn’t be downloaded. Check that the link is a public https link to an image.
errors.imageNotFound: This image is gone from the server. Pick it again.
errors.providerUnavailable: SteamGridDB isn’t answering. Try again in a moment, or upload an image.
errors.bdeUnavailable: The BDE website can’t be reached, so the event can’t come down there. Try again later, or cancel it instead.
errors.alreadyAnnounced: This event already had its new-event notification. It goes out once.
errors.notAnnouncedYet: This event hasn’t been announced yet, so there is nothing to resend.
errors.notAnnounceable: Only a published event that hasn’t started or been cancelled can be announced.
errors.inviteNotFound: This invitation doesn’t exist anymore. Reload the page.
errors.tooManyInvites: This player has too many invitations waiting for now.
errors.tooManyRequests: You already have 3 requests waiting. Withdraw one first.

events.duplicateLede: The copy is a draft, without registrations. Everything else is the same.
events.duplicateHelp: The end and the registration window move with the start.
events.cancelBody: Its page stays, marked cancelled, and registrations close. It can’t be undone, and the event can’t be edited afterwards.
events.deleteBody: The event and its page disappear for good. Only drafts and events nobody registered to can be deleted: cancel the others.
events.cancelledBody: Its page says so, and registrations are closed. It can’t be edited anymore.

empty.upcoming: No published events to come. Create one, or publish a draft.
empty.drafts: No drafts. New events start as drafts until you publish them.

form.name: Name
form.nameHelp: Short is better: the BDE website prints it very large.
form.descriptionHelp: Markdown: **bold**, lists and links. No images.
form.endsAtHelp: Filled in as start + 3 hours. Change it if needed.
form.parisTime: Paris time, whatever your device says.
form.schoolsHelp: Everyone can see the event. Only these schools’ students can register.
form.stranded: No one is affected | 1 person from an unticked school is registered. They stay registered: remove them from Registrations if needed. | {count} people from unticked schools are registered. They stay registered: remove them from Registrations if needed.
form.limitedHelp: Past the limit, people join a waitlist and get a place in order when one frees up.
form.limitedTeamsHelp: Only validated teams take a place. Past the limit, teams join a waitlist and get a place in order when one frees up.
form.teamsHelp: A tournament: players register, then create or join a team.
form.teamModeLocked: People have registered, so team mode can’t change. You can still change the team size.
form.teamSizeHelp: A team under the minimum stays public as incomplete and takes no place.
form.opensAtHelp: Optional. Empty: as soon as it’s published.
form.closesAtHelp: Optional. Empty: when the event starts.
form.priceHelp: Whole euros, paid on site. Empty: free.
form.draftHelp: Only events managers can see a draft. Turn it off to publish the event.

errors.name: Give the event a name, up to 120 characters.
errors.description: Describe the event in a few words.
errors.roomId: Pick a room, or add one.
errors.capacity: Use a whole number of places, from 1.
errors.teamMin: Use a whole number from 2 for the smallest team.
errors.teamMax: Use a whole number from the minimum up to 32 for the largest team.
errors.registrationOpensAt: Use a full date and time, or leave it empty.
errors.registrationClosesAt: Use a full date and time, or leave it empty.
errors.price: Use whole euros, from 0 to 1000, or leave it empty.
errors.endsBeforeStart: The end must come after the start.
errors.closesAfterStart: Registration must close before the event starts.
errors.opensAfterClose: Registration must open before it closes.
errors.bdeName: For the BDE website, the name needs 3 to 100 characters.
errors.bdeDescription: For the BDE website, the description needs at least 10 characters.

form.bannerEmpty: No banner: the event shows on the plain night blue. Wide art works best, 1920 × 620.
form.embedEmpty: Pick the image Discord, X and the BDE website show for this event.
form.sameEmbedHelp: Turn it off to pick another image for Discord, X and the BDE website.
form.bdeSync: Publish on the BDE website too
form.bdeSyncHelp: Its S’inscrire button sends students here. A draft stays hidden there, and a cancelled event comes down.
form.bdeOff: Not set up: the site needs the token the BDE office gives (BDE_API_TOKEN).
form.remindersHelp: Sent to registered people only, before the start. Pick as many as you need, or none.

registrations.removeBody: Their place goes to the first person on the waitlist. They aren’t told: let them know if needed.
registrations.removeWaitlistBody: They leave the waitlist. They aren’t told: let them know if needed.
registrations.addLede: Registers an account by hand, whatever its school or the registration window.
registrations.forceHelp: The event goes over its limit by one place.

picker.pickLede: Step 1 of 2. Pick art from SteamGridDB, upload your own, or paste a link.
picker.focusLede: Step 2 of 2. Click the part of the image that must always show: every crop is centered on it.
picker.searchPlaceholder: Search a game, such as Minecraft
picker.bannersHelp: Banners are 1920 × 620, the exact shape of the event banner.
picker.coversHelp: Covers are narrower: the banner keeps a band of them.
picker.noArt: No art of this kind for this game. Try the other tab, or another game.
picker.fileHelp: PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF, up to 10 MB. Wide images work best.
picker.dropHelp: Or click to choose a file.
picker.linkHelp: An https link to an image. The site downloads it once and never loads it from there again.
picker.pickLedeNoSearch: Step 1 of 2. Upload an image, or paste a link to one.

bde.failed: The BDE website refused the event
bde.pending: Waiting to reach the BDE website
bde.paused: Pushing is paused for now (feature flag). It resumes when it’s back on.
bde.nextTry: Next try at {time}, after {count} failed tries.

push.recipients: No one will be notified. | This will notify 1 person. | This will notify {count} people.
push.concerned: {audience} people are concerned. The others have this kind of notification off, or no device.
push.overCap: {count} of them already received {cap} or more this week. Nothing is blocked.
push.underCap: Nobody is over the weekly limit of {cap}.
push.unknown: The number of people couldn’t be counted. You can still continue.
push.announceBody: Accounts of the schools this event is open to, who follow new events, get it. It goes out once.
push.resendBody: Everyone who would get the announcement gets it again, including people who already received it. Only do this if the first one went wrong: people can be annoyed by a repeat.
push.rescheduleBody: Everyone on this event, registered or on the waitlist, is told it moved.
push.capacityBody: People on the waitlist get the new places.
push.addWontNotify: {name} won’t be notified: no device, or this kind of notification is off.
push.announceHeld: Notification queued. It goes out on {date} at {time}, after quiet hours.
push.heldUntil: Quiet hours are on in Paris: it will go out on {date} at {time}, not before.

teams.name: Team name
teams.makeCaptainHint: Without a captain, only managers can change the team.
teams.doubleWarning: This player is already in a team. They will count for both teams.
teams.fullWarning: This team already has {max} players, the maximum.
teams.deleteBody: The team disappears. Its players stay registered, in no team. Nobody is notified.
teams.removeBody: They stay registered, in no team. They aren’t notified.
teams.withoutNone: Everyone registered is in a team.

push.title: Push notifications
push.warn: {count} people received more than {cap} notifications this week. Nothing is blocked. Check what was sent before announcing more.
push.name: Name
push.managersSee: Events managers see the counts and the confirmations, not the list of people.
push.capHelp: Only used for warnings and counts. It never blocks a notification.
push.loadFailed: The notifications overview couldn’t be loaded. Check your connection, then reload the page.
push.empty: Nobody has turned notifications on yet.
push.quietHelp: While on, a new-event announcement sent during the quiet hours waits for their end. Reminders, waitlist places, cancellations and moves are never held. Turn it off to send announcements at any hour.

team.title: Team
team.note: People appear on the public team page with their name, school and profile photo. Ask for their agreement before adding them.
team.empty: No pole yet. Add the first one, such as the bureau.
team.noMembers: No member in this pole yet.

join.title: Join link
join.help: Where the “Join the team” button leads, such as a form or a Discord invite. It must start with https://. Leave it empty to hide the button.
join.label: Link
join.flagOff: The button is switched off in the feature flags.

pole.featuredHelp: It becomes the large band at the top of the page. Only one pole is featured.
pole.deleteLede: Only an empty pole can be deleted.

member.bioHelp: Optional. Shown under the name on the featured pole.

errors.poleNotFound: This pole no longer exists. Reload the page.
errors.memberNotFound: This member is no longer on the team. Reload the page.
errors.alreadyMember: This account is already on the team.
errors.hasMembers: Move or remove the members of this pole first.
errors.failed: The change wasn’t saved. Check your connection and try again.

partners.title: Partners
partners.note: Partners appear on the public partners page with their logo, description and link. Every partner needs a description.
partners.empty: No partner yet. Add the first one.
partners.noneInKind: No partner of this kind yet.

contact.title: Contact link
contact.help: Where the “Get in touch” button leads: an https link, or a mailto: address. Leave it empty to hide the band.
contact.label: Link
contact.flagOff: The band is switched off in the feature flags.

partner.name: Name
partner.descriptionHelp: What they do for LNB. A French text left empty shows the English one.
partner.urlHelp: Optional. It must start with https://.
partner.logoHelp: PNG, WebP or SVG, up to 1 MB. It is shown on a light plate, so dark logos work best.

errors.partnerNotFound: This partner no longer exists. Reload the page.
errors.logoNotFound: The logo is gone. Upload it again.
errors.imageTooLarge: This file is too large. Logos can be up to 1 MB.
errors.imageUnreadable: This file isn’t a PNG, WebP or SVG image we can use.
errors.failed: The change wasn’t saved. Check your connection and try again.

partners.deleteLede: The partner and its link disappear from the partners page. This can’t be undone.

partnerEvents.title: Partner events
partnerEvents.loadFailed: The event could not be loaded.
partnerEvents.closedNotice: This event is closed and read-only. Its data is deleted on {date}.
partnerEvents.missingReferent: {game} has teams but no referent. Its Manager rows in the export will be empty.

event.title: Event
event.dateHint: Shown on the page. Empty means not fixed.
event.dateConfirmedHint: Drops the “date not fixed” wording on the page.
event.interestOpenHint: Students can add or change their interest.
event.teamsOpenHint: Creating, inviting and joining. Leaving stays possible.
event.heroHint: Get the organizer’s agreement before using their visual.
event.uploaded: Image picked. Save to use it.
event.openText: Closing makes the page read-only and starts a 60-day countdown. After it, interest, teams, invitations and dates of birth are deleted. Accounts are untouched.
event.closedText: The event is closed. Everything is deleted on {date}. Reopen it to cancel the deletion.
event.closeText: The page turns read-only: no interest, teams or invitations change. Export the spreadsheet first. Interest, teams and dates of birth are deleted on {date}, 60 days from now. You can reopen the event until then.

export.title: Spreadsheet for the organizer
export.text: The organizer’s template as .xlsx: a Manager sheet with one row per team, a Joueur sheet with one row per player, and an Intérêt sheet for LNB’s own use. Every export is logged.

game.referentHint: Fills the Manager sheet. Players never see it.
game.uploaded: Image picked. Save to use it.

referent.title: Referent of {team}
referent.description: Replaces the game’s referent for this team in the export. Leave the name empty to use the game’s.

teams.title: Teams
teams.study: This game is under study: it takes interest only.

notify.title: Notification
notify.text: Sends one push notification to the accounts that turned on partner events in their notification settings. It is off by default, so expect few people. It goes out once.
notify.impactFailed: The impact could not be loaded.
notify.confirmText: This goes out once and can’t be sent again.
notify.overCap: {count} of them already received {cap} notifications or more this week.

shortLinks.title: Short links
shortLinks.note: A short link sends people from /go/lan-party, for example, to another page. It can count clicks, ask people to sign in, or stay inside some schools.
shortLinks.empty: No short link yet. Create the first one.
shortLinks.deleteLede: The link stops working and its click history is deleted. This can’t be undone.

form.destinationHelp: Where people end up. It must start with https://.
form.shortIdHelp: Letters, numbers and dashes. Leave it empty to get a random one. It can’t change later.
form.name: Name

any.label: Anyone
any.description: No sign-in. Clicks are counted, nothing else.

signed.label: Signed-in students
signed.description: Asks people to sign in, then redirects.

schools.label: Some schools only
schools.description: Signed in, and from the schools you pick.

form.recordHelp: Keeps the name and school of each signed-in person who opens it. The sign-in page tells them.
form.recordNeedsSignIn: Needs sign-in. Without it LNB only counts clicks.
form.recordFlagOff: Switched off in the feature flags.
form.enabledHelp: When off, the link shows a page saying it doesn’t work.

summary.any: Anyone with the link can open it, signed in or not. Clicks are counted, nobody is identified.
summary.signed: Anyone signed in with an allowed school account can open it. Everyone else is asked to sign in first.
summary.schools: Only students of {schools} can open it. Others see a page that says so.

detail.title: Link
detail.trackingOff: Recording who clicks is switched off in the feature flags, so new clicks are counted without names.
detail.shown: Showing {shown} of {total}. Only admins see this list.
detail.hintAny: Anyone can open this link without signing in, so LNB only counts clicks. To see who clicked, require sign-in and turn on “Record who clicks”.
detail.hintEnable: Turn on “Record who clicks” in Edit to see which people opened this link.

errors.shortLinkNotFound: This link no longer exists. Reload the page.
errors.shortIdTaken: This short link is already used. Pick another one.
errors.failed: The change wasn’t saved. Check your connection and try again.

apiKeys.title: API keys
apiKeys.note: A key lets an integration, such as the BDE website or a bot, call the API with only the permissions you give it. Every key expires within a year.
apiKeys.empty: No API key yet. Create the first one when an integration needs access.
apiKeys.offDescription: Every key is refused with a 503 until the feature flag is back on.

events.label: Events
events.description: Hidden events and who is registered

events_read_hidden.label: Read hidden events
events_read_hidden.description: Drafts and the admin view of every event. Public events need no key.

registrations_read.label: Read registrations
registrations_read.description: Who is registered or on the waitlist, with their email and school.

registrations_write.label: Register people
registrations_write.description: Add or remove a registration for an account. It never goes past an event’s limit.

links_read.label: Read short links
links_read.description: List links with their click counts, and see one link’s statistics.

links_create.label: Create short links
links_create.description: Make a new link. Existing ones stay untouched.

warden_read.label: Read Warden players
warden_read.description: Linked Minecraft accounts, bans and sessions of a player.

form.title: New API key
form.name: Name
form.nameHelp: Say what uses the key. It shows in the admin log.
form.descriptionPlaceholder: What it does and who looks after it
form.expiresHelp: Every key expires. You can rotate it before then.
form.blocked: Keys can never ban accounts, change roles, delete users or change the rate limiting mode. Those routes don’t accept a key.

detail.noCalls: No call in the last 7 days.
detail.soonNote: This key expires in {days} days. Rotate it so the integration isn’t cut off.
detail.rotatingNote: A newer key replaced this one. It stops working on {date}.
detail.loadFailed: This key couldn’t be loaded. Check your connection, then try again.

secret.title: Copy your key now
secret.ledeRotated: The new key for “{name}”. The old one keeps working for {days} more days.
secret.warning: This is the only time the whole key is shown. LNB keeps a hash, so it can’t be recovered. If you lose it, rotate the key.
secret.usage: Send it as Authorization: Bearer followed by the key.

rotate.title: Rotate “{name}”?
rotate.lede: A new key is made with the same permissions and a new one-year expiry. The old key keeps working during the overlap so you can switch without downtime.
rotate.overlap: Keep the old key working for

revoke.title: Revoke “{name}”?
revoke.lede: It stops working right away and can’t be turned back on. Anything using it gets a 401 on its next call.
revoke.lastUsed: Last used {when}. It made {calls} calls in the last 7 days.

errors.apiKeyNotFound: This key no longer exists. Reload the page.
errors.apiKeyNotUsable: This key can’t be rotated: it is revoked, expired or already replaced.
errors.failed: That didn’t work. Check your connection, then try again.

economy.lede: Money in circulation, what was created and destroyed, and how it moves between players.
economy.loadFailed: The economy couldn’t be loaded. Check your connection, then reload the page.

charts.supplyLabel: Money in circulation went from {from} to {to} LNBits.
charts.flowLabel: {minted} LNBits created and {burned} destroyed over the period.

reasons.title: By reason
reasons.empty: Nothing created or destroyed over the period.

wealth.title: Wealth distribution
wealth.histogramLabel: Number of players per balance range

adjust.title: Adjust {name}
adjust.lede: Mint creates LNBits on this account, burn destroys them. Its members see it as an adjustment from LNB, with your reason.
adjust.reasonHelp: Required. Members see it in their history, and it goes in the audit log.

freeze.title: Freeze {name}?
freeze.lede: No money goes in or out, except your adjustments and reversals. Members see that it’s frozen.

reverse.title: Reverse this transaction?
reverse.lede: A new transaction moves {amount} LNBits back. It’s refused if an account no longer holds the money.

settings.startingBalanceHelp: Minted on each new personal account. 0 for none.
settings.maxOwnedSharedHelp: How many shared accounts one player can own.

reset.heading: Reset the economy
reset.lede: Deletes every account, the whole ledger and the stats. The settings stay. Download the export first to keep a copy.
reset.title: Reset the economy?
reset.warning: Every balance goes back to zero and every shared account disappears. This can’t be undone.

players.search: Search by name, email or Minecraft username
players.empty: No players match. Try another name, or clear the filters.
players.loadFailed: The players couldn’t be loaded. Check your connection, then reload the page.

appeals.empty: No appeals waiting. New ones show up here.
appeals.responsePlaceholder: Explain your decision to the player
appeals.needResponse: Write a response for the player first.

activity.empty: Nothing yet. Changes show up here as they happen.

actions.limitReset: Account limit back to the default
actions.uuidCollision: {username} kept its old UUID: the offline one is already linked

settings.maxAccountsHelp: How many Minecraft accounts each player can link. A player’s own limit wins over this one.

player.siteAdminOnly: Only site admins can change the Warden admin role.
player.unlinkBody: Its playtime and sessions stay, and it’s kicked from the server if it’s playing. The player can link it again. If someone else links it, they take it over and admins get a warning about it.
player.roleOnBody: They can ban, unban and warn players from here and in-game, and see the activity log.
player.loadFailed: This player couldn’t be loaded. Check your connection, then reload the page.
player.revokeDeviceBody: The device is signed out right away, and disconnected if it’s playing. The player can link it again.

transfers.title: Account takeovers
transfers.hint: The account was unlinked, then linked by someone else. The username proves nothing on this server, so check it isn’t an impersonation. Players don’t see this.

banModal.title: Ban {name}
banModal.lede: The ban covers every Minecraft account they’ve linked, and replaces their current ban.
banModal.never: Never ends. Only an admin can lift it.
banModal.pickDate: Pick when the ban ends, in the future.

limitModal.title: Account limit for {name}
limitModal.lede: How many Minecraft accounts this player can link. Accounts already linked stay linked.

errors.failed: That didn’t work. Check your connection, then try again.
errors.notFound: This player or ban doesn’t exist anymore. Reload the page.
errors.notBanned: This player isn’t banned anymore. Reload the page.
errors.appealClosed: Another admin already answered this appeal. Reload the page.
errors.notLinked: This account isn’t linked anymore. Reload the page.
errors.alreadyDismissed: Another admin already dismissed this. Reload the page.

mods.title: Mod list
mods.lede: Vote on the mods for the LNB Minecraft server, and suggest the ones you want to see. The Minecraft team picks the official list.
mods.officialLede: These mods are on the server. Your votes tell the Minecraft team what to keep.
mods.loadFailed: The mod list couldn’t be loaded. Check your connection, then reload the page.
mods.bannedNotice: You’re banned from the Minecraft server, so you can’t vote or suggest mods until the ban ends.

empty.official: The official list is empty for now. The Minecraft team adds mods here.
empty.suggestions: No suggestions yet. Suggest the first mod below.

vote.own: You can’t vote on your own suggestion
vote.banned: You can’t vote while you’re banned from the Minecraft server

search.label: Mod
search.empty: No mods match. Try another name, or check the spelling.
search.sources: Results come from Modrinth first. Mods that aren’t on Modrinth come from CurseForge.

suggest.title: Suggest a mod
suggest.lede: It must run on {loader} {version}. You have {left} of {max} suggestions left.
suggest.reasonHelp: Your name and reason are shown with the suggestion.
suggest.reasonPlaceholder: What it adds to the server, and who it’s for.
suggest.panelLeft: You’ve used all your suggestions. Withdraw one to suggest another mod. | Suggest it and everyone can vote on it. You have {left} of {max} suggestions left. | Suggest it and everyone can vote on it. You have {left} of {max} suggestions left.
suggest.panelSignedOut: Sign in to suggest a mod and vote on the list.

reason.title: Edit your reason for {name}
reason.lede: The votes stay as they are.

withdraw.title: Withdraw {name}?
withdraw.body: Your suggestion and its votes are deleted. You can suggest another mod in its place.

errors.closed: Voting and suggestions are closed for now.
errors.banned: You can’t do this while you’re banned from the Minecraft server.
errors.ownMod: You can’t vote on your own suggestion.
errors.limitReached: You’ve used all your suggestions. Withdraw one to suggest another mod.
errors.duplicate: This mod is already in the list. Vote on it instead.
errors.removed: The Minecraft team removed this mod from the suggestions, so it can’t be suggested again.
errors.incompatible: This mod doesn’t run on the server’s Minecraft version and loader.
errors.notFound: This mod isn’t in the list anymore. Reload the page.
errors.notSuggestion: This suggestion was already handled. Reload the page.
errors.notOfficial: This mod isn’t in the official list anymore. Reload the page.
errors.rateLimited: Too many searches. Wait a minute, then try again.
errors.manual: Mods added by hand have no source to refresh from.
errors.sourceUnavailable: Modrinth and CurseForge can’t be reached right now. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.failed: That didn’t work. Check your connection, then try again.

toSuggestions.title: Don’t see the mods you like?
toSuggestions.body: Members suggested 1 more mod. Vote on it, or suggest your own. | Members suggested {count} more mods. Vote on them, or suggest your own.
toSuggestions.bodyEmpty: Members can suggest more mods. Be the first to suggest one.

spot.title: A place opened for you
spot.body: You have a place at {name} on {date} at {time}.

cancelled.title: Cancelled: {name}
cancelled.body: The event on {date} no longer takes place.

validated.title: {team} is registered
validated.body: The team has a place at {name} on {date}.

place.title: {team} got a place
place.body: The team now has a place at {name} on {date}.

waitlist.title: {team} is on the waiting list
waitlist.body: The team is complete, and waits for a place at {name}.

partnerEvent.title: {name}
partnerEvent.body: Say you’re interested and form a team with other students.

prompt.title: Stay in the loop on your events
prompt.intro: We only send notifications about events. No ads, no news. About 3 a week at most.
gets: A reminder before an event you registered for
A place opens for you on a waitlist
An event you’re on is cancelled or moved
prompt.enabled: Notifications are on for this device
prompt.snoozedDays: We won’t ask again for {days} days. You can turn notifications on in your account.
prompt.snoozedNever: We won’t ask again. You can turn notifications on in your account.
prompt.denied: Notifications weren’t allowed. You can change that in your browser’s site settings.
prompt.failed: Notifications couldn’t be turned on. Check your connection, then try again from your account.

settings.intro: Only about events. No ads. About 3 a week at most.

newEvents.label: New events
newEvents.description: When the BDE announces an event

spots.label: Waitlist places
spots.description: When a place opens for you or your team, a manager adds you, or a team invites you or answers

partnerEvents.label: Partner events
partnerEvents.description: When LNB announces an event another organization runs, such as Arena League University. Off until you turn it on.

settings.adminSees: Admins can see that you turned notifications on.
settings.blocked: Your browser blocks notifications for this site. Allow them in the site settings of your browser, then come back here.

settings.unsupported: This browser can’t receive notifications. Try another browser or device.
settings.disabled: Notifications are switched off for now. Your choices are kept.
settings.failed: That didn’t work. Check your connection, then try again.
settings.notConfigured: Notifications aren’t set up on this server yet. Ask an admin to add the push keys.

team.title: The LNB team
team.lede: Students from Epitech, e-artsup and ISEG who run the evenings, tournaments, IRL games and the Minecraft server. Come say hi at the next event.
team.empty: The team will show up here soon.

join.title: Want to help run LNB?
join.lede: Tell us what you would like to work on.

partners.title: Our partners
partners.lede: The companies and studios that help LNB run evenings, tournaments and IRL games.
partners.empty: Our partners will show up here soon.

sponsor.name: Sponsors
sponsor.lede: They give us money, equipment or food, so evenings and tournaments can happen.

game.name: Game partners
game.lede: Studios and publishers who give us game keys for prizes and giveaways.

prize.name: Prize partners
prize.lede: Brands that give gifts for tournament winners and giveaways.

contact.title: Want to support LNB?
contact.lede: Tell us what you can offer and we will find the right fit: prizes, food, equipment or game keys.

signIn.title: Sign in to open this link
signIn.any: This link is for students of Epitech, e-artsup and ISEG.

arenaLeague2027.title: Arena League University 2027
arenaLeague2027.lede: A first season of inter-school esports between universities, on League of Legends and VALORANT. Rocket League and Counter-Strike 2 are under study.
arenaLeague2027.dateNotFixed: Date not fixed, probably January to May
arenaLeague2027.notice: LNB is not the organizer. We collect which students are interested and give the organizer the list. Teams are formed afterwards, and final registration comes once the organizer has validated the teams and the eligibility rules.

interest.title: Say you’re interested
interest.text: Pick your games and tell us your in-game name and rank. It takes a minute.

teams.title: Teams come next
teams.text: Teams are formed with LNB’s help once interest is in. Each team gets a referent from LNB, who is the contact with the organizer.

free.title: Free and mostly online
free.text: There is no fee for students or schools. Matches are mostly online, on a calendar shared before the launch.

promo.lede: Inter-school esports league on League of Legends and VALORANT. Free for students.
